name: Imae Yoshinori
source: Lord of Higo. His personality is perverse and insidious. His invasion of Hizen was largely motivated by having exhausted all desirable women within Higo and seeking new prey. During intimate encounters, he forces women to utter vulgarities, earning him the nickname 'Lord of Lewdness'. Women who fail to satisfy him with obscene talk are given to his subordinates as comfort women, treated like public toilets.
